Hi all -

First, Shiny is pure magic and invaluable. Thank you all so much -- and thanks to the community here, which is fantastic.

I've got a matrixinput table; the first column contains scenario numbers. Those become necessary for some later manipulation and plotting.

I realize this is pretty esoteric, but I figured it was worth a shot.

Thanks -

Ajay

Hi Patrick -- thanks for all your help. I figured out a bit of a hack using jQuery:

function rowCount(){
    var rowCount = $('#intvnParams tbody tr').length;
    var rowCount2 = $('#intvnParams tbody tr').length +1;
    if(rowCount>4){
      $('#intvnParams tr:eq('+parseInt(rowCount)+') td:eq(1)').html("<div tabindex='0'>" +(rowCount) + "</div");
      $('#intvnParams tr:eq('+parseInt(rowCount)+') td:eq(0)').html("<div tabindex='0'>User Defined</div");
      $('#intvnParams tbody tr').trigger('change');
    }
  };
      setInterval(rowCount, 0500);

I wasn't able to get it to trigger on clock of the add row button, which would be better than using setInterval -- but it works. The code above is pretty application specific, but could be tweaked to be more universal.

Thanks again.

Ajay
